claims: Africa is the world's second-largest continent.
Africa is the world's second-most populous continent.
Africa covers 20% of Earth's land area.
Africa has over 1.5 billion people.
Africa has 54 nations.
Africa has the world's youngest population.
The median age in Africa is around 19.7.
The Sahara is the largest hot desert.
The Nile is the longest river.
Africa has natural resources including diamonds, oil, and minerals.
Africa hosts over 3,000 distinct ethnic groups.
Africa hosts over 2,000 languages.
Islam and Christianity are major religions in Africa.
Cairo is in Egypt.
Lagos is in Nigeria.
Cape Town is in South Africa.
Serengeti is in Tanzania.
Sub-Saharan Africa is the area south of the Sahara desert.
Central Africa is also called Middle Africa.
Central Africa is dominated by the Congo Basin rainforest
